subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “At home, his father cleaned it and placed it near the window.”?
options: Then they got used to the correct time.
Students put their homework there every morning.
The teacher used the moment for discussion.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Then they got used to the correct time.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「At home, his father cleaned it and placed it near the window. Henry used it for homework.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students put their homework there every morning.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher used the moment for discussion.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「At home, his father cleaned it and placed it near the window. Henry used it for homework.」，答案為「Henry used it for homework.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Henry used it for homework.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
